sources.snippet: The model is pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset. LeViT-128s model is a small LeViT variant that has 128 channels on input of the transformer stage and 2, 3 and 4 number of pairs of Attention and MLP blocks at 1, 2 and 3 model stages respectively. The model input is a blob that consists of a single image of 1, 3, 224, 224 in RGB order.
